title: Aey salaami peer marthay hain jawaan kay saamney
body:
Aey salaami peer marthay hain jawaan kay saamney
Haif Akbar ney qazaa ki baap maan kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Shair-e-Hyder sey kaheen chutt-thi hai darya ki khachaar
Rauza-e-Abbas hai aab-e-rawaan kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Ronay waaloun ko Shaheed-e-Karbala baad-e-fanaa
Khuld mein deingay makaan apney makaan kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunti hoon ek naujawaan beta hai Hum Shakl-e-Nabi
Behray deed aatha hai aalam is jawaan kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab-e-Zeejah ney paala hai isko goudh mein
Biyaah ho jaldi Elaahi baap maan kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Hind sey Zainab yeh boli sar ko apney peett kar
Margaya barchi sey woh mujh neemjaan kay samney
<<DIVIDER>>
Boley Sajjad-e-Hazeen Akbar faqath kya margaye
Sab tawaana margaye mujh naatawaan kay saamney
